audience: information-systems researchers and practitioners — technical, but not specialists in this field

concepts.title: Why a funnel, and not one big model
concepts.objective: Compute per candidate rises by orders of magnitude from left to right while the number of candidates falls, which is the only reason the funnel has that shape.
concepts.takeaway: The cascade is not a modelling insight. It is a compute constraint made visible.
concepts.brief: Four stages left to right, each narrower than the last, with the candidate count falling and the cost per candidate rising. Show both numbers.
